audio_noise_floor.label: Background noise floor (LAeq, unoccupied)
audio_noise_floor.method: LAeq over 60 s at the seating reference, HVAC on, unoccupied, class 1 meter

audio_mic_pickup.label: Microphone pickup coverage at every seat
audio_mic_pickup.method: talker at each seat into a far-end monitor; level and clarity logged per seat

audio_zone_routing.label: Zone routing and mute/volume mapping
audio_zone_routing.method: every DSP output zone driven in turn; UI mute/volume acts on the right zone

audio_limiter_levels.label: Limiter and safe listening level
audio_limiter_levels.method: limiter threshold verified; programme peak at the nearest seat below the site safe-level reference

audio_assisted_listening.label: Assistive listening path
audio_assisted_listening.method: programme audio reaches the assistive system receiver with the same mute state

audio_dsp_firmware.label: DSP firmware against the baseline
audio_dsp_firmware.method: firmware read from the device; compared with the campus baseline and the vendor support horizon

video_display_calibration.label: Display picture settings and calibration
video_display_calibration.method: picture mode, brightness and colour against the room standard; test pattern photographed

video_edid_handshake.label: EDID / HDCP handshake on every input
video_edid_handshake.method: every source to every sink; resolution and HDCP state recorded

video_content_share.label: Wireless and wired content sharing
video_content_share.method: laptop share by cable and wirelessly; audio follows video

video_camera_exposure.label: Camera exposure and white balance
video_camera_exposure.method: exposure and white balance set for the lighting scenes; reference capture per scene

video_camera_tracking.label: Camera tracking behaviour
video_camera_tracking.method: tracking mode exercised with two talkers; framing transitions observed and rated against the design intent

video_switching.label: Video switching and routing matrix
video_switching.method: every route in the switching plan; switching time noted

video_av_sync.label: Audio/video synchronisation
video_av_sync.method: lip-sync test clip at the display and loudspeakers; offset measured

uc_calendar.label: Calendar / scheduling integration
uc_calendar.method: a booked meeting appears on the room panel and joins in one touch

uc_peripherals.label: UC peripheral enumeration
uc_peripherals.method: camera, microphone and loudspeaker enumerated by the UC engine as designed

compute_display_capability.label: Display count within the compute model's capability record
compute_display_capability.method: displays in the design against the per-model capability record (GPU, platform, certified configuration) — no universal maximum

compute_patch_baseline.label: Compute OS and application patch baseline
compute_patch_baseline.method: OS build and UC application version read from the device against the baseline

compute_certified_config.label: Certified configuration match
compute_certified_config.method: compute + peripherals as a certified bundle per the vendor record on file

control_source_switching.label: Source switching from the UI
control_source_switching.method: every source button routes the right signal

control_audio.label: Audio control (mute, volume, zones)
control_audio.method: mute states and volume limits from the UI act on the DSP

control_camera.label: Camera control (PTZ, presets) from the UI
control_camera.method: presets and manual PTZ from the UI

control_macros.label: Room automation macros (start / end meeting)
control_macros.method: start and end macros leave every device in the designed state

control_ups.label: UPS graceful power-failure behaviour
control_ups.method: mains removed under supervision; devices shut down and recover in order

control_error_states.label: Error handling and offline states
control_error_states.method: a device unplugged: the UI says so and recovers

control_time_sync.label: Time synchronisation (NTP)
control_time_sync.method: processor and panels synchronised to the site time source

control_program_version.label: Control program and UI build recorded
control_program_version.method: program and UI build versions read from the processor and archived with their hashes

control_third_party.label: Third-party integrations from the UI (DSP / UC / shades)
control_third_party.method: each integrated system responds to the UI and reports state back

network_port_profile.label: Switch port profile per device
network_port_profile.method: port description, speed/duplex and PoE class against the port map

network_firmware_baseline.label: Network device firmware baseline
network_firmware_baseline.method: switch firmware read and compared with the baseline

network_addressing.label: Addressing, DHCP reservations and DNS
network_addressing.method: every device at its planned address and hostname; DNS resolves

network_management_reach.label: Management reachability from the monitoring host
network_management_reach.method: the FI v1.3 collector host reaches the device management interface (reachability only — never performance)

network_media_clock.label: AVoIP / networked-audio clocking
network_media_clock.method: clock leader elected as designed; no clock flapping over the observation window

network_config_backup.label: Network configuration backed up
network_config_backup.method: switch configuration exported, hashed and stored

infra_cable_certification.label: Structured cabling certification
infra_cable_certification.method: certification report per link from the installer's tester

infra_labeling.label: Device, cable and port labelling
infra_labeling.method: labels match the register and the port map; photographed

infra_rack_match.label: Rack elevation matches the drawing
infra_rack_match.method: rack photographed and compared with the elevation

power_circuit_load.label: Circuit load and dedicated supply
power_circuit_load.method: nameplate load per circuit against capacity; dedicated circuits where the design requires

power_ups_runtime.label: UPS runtime under load
power_ups_runtime.method: runtime estimate read from the UPS under the connected load

env_lighting_levels.label: Lighting levels at the camera and the displays
env_lighting_levels.method: lux at the talker position and glare on displays per scene

access_hearing.label: Hearing accessibility provision
access_hearing.method: assistive listening or captioning path available and signed

access_captions.label: Live captions path in the UC platform
access_captions.method: captions enabled in a test call and visible on the room display

access_reach.label: Control reach and operable parts
access_reach.method: panel height and reach range within the accessibility standard on file

access_contrast.label: UI contrast and text size
access_contrast.method: UI theme contrast and minimum text size checked on the panel

cyber_default_credentials.label: Default credentials changed on every device
cyber_default_credentials.method: login with vendor defaults refused on each device; credentials in the vault

cyber_management_isolation.label: Management interfaces isolated to the AV management VLAN
cyber_management_isolation.method: management ports unreachable from the user VLAN

cyber_firmware_signed.label: Firmware from the vendor's signed channel
cyber_firmware_signed.method: firmware source and hash recorded from the vendor release

cyber_tls.label: Certificates and encrypted management
cyber_tls.method: management over TLS with a trusted certificate; plaintext management disabled

cyber_accounts.label: Service accounts reviewed and least-privilege
cyber_accounts.method: accounts on each device listed; installer accounts removed

cyber_logging.label: Device logging to the monitoring host
cyber_logging.method: syslog / audit events reach the collector host

integ_monitoring_enrol.label: Enrolled in Field Intelligence monitoring (v1.3, read-only)
integ_monitoring_enrol.method: devices in the collector inventory; first scheduled observation on record

integ_itsm.label: ITSM configuration items created and linked
integ_itsm.method: CI per device with the room relationship; ticket routing tested

integ_signage_cms.label: Signage CMS enrolment
integ_signage_cms.method: player enrolled; a test playlist published and received

integ_lighting_shades.label: Lighting and shade scene integration
integ_lighting_shades.method: scenes mapped from the AV UI to the lighting controller

integ_bms.label: Building management hand-off (occupancy, HVAC)
integ_bms.method: occupancy signal and after-hours state agreed with the BMS owner

interop_mixed_vendor.label: Mixed-vendor interoperability matrix
interop_mixed_vendor.method: every vendor pairing in the signal path exercised; the matrix filled per pairing

interop_firmware_matrix.label: Firmware compatibility matrix
interop_firmware_matrix.method: installed firmware pairings against the vendors' published compatibility

handover_training.label: User and operator training delivered
handover_training.method: attendance recorded; quick-start guide left in the room

handover_support_path.label: Support path and owners confirmed
handover_support_path.method: primary and backup owner per domain; escalation tested with a dry run

handover_spares.label: Spares and consumables stocked
handover_spares.method: spares per the design list received into stock

handover_warranty.label: Warranty and licence register
handover_warranty.method: serials, warranty end and licences registered per asset

handover_runbook.label: Operations runbook accepted
handover_runbook.method: runbook reviewed by the operations owner
